transcript.text: Airport launch ke bahar khamesha aapko 2-3 log aise milenge, jo ki alag-alag cards nikal rahe hain, swipe kar rahe hain, lekin phir bhi unko launch access nahi mil raha. Kyuki unke card pe koi na koi minimum spend criteria hoga, launch access ke liye monthly yaa phir quarterly jo unhe poora nahi kiya hoga. Aur yeh sirf inki problem nahi, kaafi cards jo hume pehle free launch access ka benefit dete the, wo ab devalue ho chuke hain.
